goal: Crowdsource verification of hardcoded AssumeUTXO snapshot commitments during standard sync
Alert node operators if the reconstructed UTXO state contradicts compiled snapshot data
agreement: Concept support for crowdsourcing snapshot checks across standard syncing nodes (Sjors, optout21)
Resolved objections to halting or crashing on mismatch by downgrading to non-fatal warnings (Sjors, ajtowns)
Suggestion to persist the mismatch warning across node restarts is still open (fametrano)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it decentralizes verification of hardcoded snapshot commitments across all syncing nodes
The integrity benefit is deferrable since snapshot nodes already validate full history in the background
